cascade.score_note: detectMultiScale3 levelWeights order boxes; not calibrated probabilities; minNeighbors is an operating parameter

matching.rule: greedy, highest score first, same class only, each ground-truth box matched at most once
matching.zero_denominator: report 0.0 for precision or recall when the denominator is zero, and state that it is a zero-denominator case rather than a measured score

operating_point_rule: maximise recall subject to precision >= 0.60 (review-queue application: a false positive costs one reviewer glance, a false negative never reaches a human at all). If no parameter value satisfies the constraint, the verdict is DO NOT DEPLOY - do not relax the rule to manufacture one.
distribution_note: These are SYNTHETIC schematic targets rendered with OpenCV. Every number here describes the detectors on THIS distribution and does not transfer to photographic data.
